summary: The statement and proof are correct. The positive-pair formulas, distinct block-vector construction, and supermultiplicativity of the minimum justify the global mass bound. The four exact small-scale arithmetic checks, both amplification inductions, and the discarded-coordinate tail sum are valid. The discarded target product is at most exp(999/2), yielding the stated inequality with the stronger constant exp(-999/2). Parameters equal to zero or one, arbitrarily small positive parameters, empty retained-block sets, and attainment of the maximum are all covered without gaps.
